subject: humanities
passage: A monthly Urdu poetry magazine published in Lahore, Pakistan, began posting each issue online in 2019 while continuing to sell printed copies. Editor Ayesha Rana reported that within a few years the magazine's online readers outnumbered its print buyers, even though print sales fell only slightly. According to the graph, the first year in which online readers outnumbered print copies sold was ______

data.title: Average Monthly Readership of an Urdu Poetry Magazine

stem: Which choice most effectively uses data from the graph to complete the statement?

choices.A: 2019, when print sales were about 12,000 copies.

explanation.why: The question asks for the first year the online line rose above the print line. In 2021 online readers (about 10,400) were still below print copies (about 11,500), but in 2022 online readers (about 13,900) passed print copies (about 11,100).
explanation.A: Incorrect. This is true, but in 2019 print copies far outnumbered online readers (about 12,000 versus 2,500).
explanation.B: Incorrect. In 2021 online readers were about 10,400, still fewer than the roughly 11,500 print copies sold.
explanation.C: Incorrect. Online readers did outnumber print copies in 2024, but they had already done so in 2022 and 2023, so 2024 was not the first year.
explanation.D: Correct. 2022 is the first year the online line is above the print line: about 13,900 online readers versus about 11,100 print copies.
